resolved_review_note.issue: Version 1 inferred complete purchased-row coverage from first-page totals while pages beyond row 10 had not been inspected. Arithmetic alone was not an exhaustive 36-row audit.
resolved_review_note.resolution: Version 2 records root expansion to 50 rows, pagination 1-36 of 36, four nonzero purchased rows and 32 other rows with zero purchased quantity and revenue, with no negative rows and unchanged September 13 scope. The provisional inference fields were removed.
resolved_review_note.independence_limit: Reviewer verified revision hashes, recorded coverage predicates and public-row arithmetic; reviewer did not inspect the native 36-row report or replay the operator parser.

independence.statement: Root reports an exact private transaction-ID match to a schema-validated minimal Shopify legacyResourceId query and subsequent runtime clearing. Redacted artifacts do not permit independent replay of that join, verification of the excluded identifier/digest, or verification of runtime clearing. This PASS is for bounded saved-source reconciliation, not independent live acceptance.

acceptance_limits: One reported purchase and four matching public item rows support bounded GA4 report-level ingestion/value/item evidence for this US sample. The item report is aggregate and is not a raw item payload joined to the transaction row.

GA4 reporting currency USD is not proof of raw event currency. This zero-tax, zero-shipping, zero-refund, undiscounted sample does not validate those treatments or currency conversion for other orders.
The completed New York calendar date still has native intraday and mostly-complete data warnings. Unsampled means 100% of available data, not final processing.

The native session_start/ad_user_data warning is a report-level diagnostic. No underlying event ordering or individual consent choice was independently observed or reproduced; no production correction is authorized by the warning alone.
One displayed transaction does not establish sender deduplication. No synthetic purchase or replay is needed or authorized by this review.

No new Ads read occurred in the receiver pass. The earlier Awaiting conversions/zero-conversion action read is a dated baseline and does not prove failure; Shopify PAID status is not paid-media attribution.

Costs, retained profit, Ads attribution, full measurement acceptance, international accuracy and launch readiness remain unresolved. Existing paused campaign status is a prior source fact, not newly verified here.

privacy.limits: Local redacted-artifact checks do not independently prove exclusion of an unknown private numeric identifier or verify deletion of private runtime values.
